bank_leakage.metric: coverage(question, event) = |T(question) & T(event)| / |T(question)|, T(s) = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]{3,}', s.lower()))
bank_leakage.non_target_exhaustive_definition: per golden, the mean coverage over EVERY non-target event of the same attempt; no seed, no draw
bank_leakage.non_target_sampled_definition: one uniformly random non-target event of the same attempt, seed 7

control.haystack: events of the bound attempt only

note: measurement only; ownership question (d) is the owner's to decide and no default, checkbox or promotion moves here
question: how much of the measured coding-lane win survives when the lexical give-away is removed from the instrument

stages.fused: ranked candidate list, via gold_fused_rank (single-span bank)
stages.packed: what reaches a reader, via the runner's hit_at_k over packed bodies

survival_vs_original_bank.definition: margin = MemPhant(after) recall - scoped BM25 control recall, on that bank's own questions; survival_ratio = paraphrase margin / original margin. A ratio near 1 means the win was not an artifact of the lexical give-away; near 0 means it was; negative means the ordering reverses once the give-away is removed.

why_diagnostic: the bank this runs on FAILED its own preregistered headline leakage criterion (concentration 2.0180 against a bar of <= 1.50) and is used here deliberately and with that failure declared, because it is still a far less lexically confounded instrument than the original bank at 3.9286. No number here may be promoted, published or cited as a standing measurement.
